question: What understanding has been gained through the grace of the lord of Kaulas?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas.
Knowledge has come by that lord's grace.
The speaker claims to know the determination of Kaula.
inference: By the lord of Kaulas' grace, the speaker has come to know the Kaula doctrine.
plain_english: O lord of Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
